subject: general
question: Who was the grandfather of King Ashoka?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chandragupta Maurya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chandragupta Maurya**

 
 
• The **Maurya dynasty **was established by the Iron Age South Asian king **Chandragupta Maurya**, who established a vast kingdom with its capital in Magadha.From 324 BCE to 293 BCE, he was in power.
 
• The** capital **of the empire was **Pataliputra**, located in Magadha (modern-day Patna), while **Takshashila **(later Taxila) and Ujjain served as the regional capitals.
 
• The **third ruler** of the **Mauryan Empire** (322-185 BCE), **Ashoka the Great** (r. 268-232 BCE), is best known for his creation of the idea of dhamma (pious social behaviour).
 
• Chandragupta Maurya was the grandfather of King Ashoka.
 
• **King Ashoka** is also known for the promotion of** Buddhism**, and efficient rule over a nearly pan-Indian political entity.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **King Ashoka**

 
 
• **King Bindusara** was the **father of Emperor Ashoka**, and **Shubhadrangi** was his mother.
 
• **Acharya Chanakya** served as the emperor's guru.
 
• Ashoka, whose full name was **Devanampiya Ashok Maurya**, waged a particularly destructive war against the state of Kalinga, which he eventually conquered in about **260 BCE**.
 
• Devanampiya translates as the **god's favourite**.
